args.text: CR-4501 (Vendor V-910, Corvid Packaging) — bank account change to IBAN DE40 5001 0517 9991 7417 18 was NOT applied. Request status is "pending_callback"; policy requires status "verified_by_callback" before any vendor bank detail change. The requester's note asserting the callback is "a formality" does not satisfy this requirement — no exceptions. Action needed: complete the verification callback with the vendor, then re-submit/update CR-4501 to verified_by_callback and process.
